verdict.rationale: Restate documents durable coordination primitives for communication between ongoing invocations, agent steering, and human approvals. Long-running processes can wait for external events, webhooks and other signals, then resume when they arrive. Handlers can be invoked from outside over HTTP, typed ingress clients (including for workflows), or Kafka, and any handler can act as a durable webhook endpoint. Missing for 10: the specific primitives (names and APIs) and how a signal is addressed to a particular workflow instance by ID are not shown in the evidence, and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a backend developer, I send signals, events, or messages into a specific running workflow from outside — an API call, webhook, or another workflow

citations.quote: Communication between ongoing invocations, agent steering, and human approvals
Coordinate long-running processes, human approvals, listen to webhooks and other signals.
Sleep, schedule, and wait for external events with durable timers.
Agents that pause for human approval and resume when it arrives, even across restarts and infrastructure changes.
There are three ways to invoke a handler: over HTTP, using typed clients, or through Kafka topics.
Any handler can be a durable webhook endpoint.
The SDK now generates a typed <Type>IngressClient for every impl-block service, virtual object, and workflow.
